name: Knott's Cantina Del Sur (Fiesta Village) Carne Asada or Pollo Street Tacos (Plain Meat & Tortilla Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Cantina Del Sur (Fiesta Village · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Simple grilled steak or chicken street tacos on warm soft tortillas—ordering them "meat only" without raw diced onions, cilantro, or lime keeps them clean.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Carne Asada or Pollo Tacos plain (meat and tortilla only, no raw onion or cilantro) and do not use the lime wedges or hot salsa.
watchOuts: Skip the margaritas and citrus agua frescas at the cantina window
